svg.aria-label: An image cut into a 16 by 16 grid of patches, then a sequence of 261 tokens
svg.text: each token is a vector of d = 768 numbers (a row of the matrix X ∈ ℝ²⁶¹ˣ⁷⁶⁸)
Same sequence enters every layer; its length (261) and width (768) never change.
green = patch tokens · orange = class token · purple = registers
